props.title: A Bug Was Fixed in Three Places. A Stranger Found the Fourth.

props.text: A community contributor found the fourth instance of a locale-threading bug that had been fixed three times before, while the Aeon framework independently shipped a requirement for live behavioral proof — human and machine converging on the same lesson. MiroShark at 1,453 stars, 300 forks, 21 contributors, 186 days of continuous autonomous operation.
